description: A stage move goes through `chief-of-stuff log --stage`, which sets the stage cell and writes the structured `stage: <name> → <stage>` Log line the board's Flow charts read. Enforces: "Move `stage` with `chief-of-stuff log --root . --stage "<name>" <stage>` when the task moves, once for every stage it enters, even two in one move: it sets the cell and writes the `stage: <name> → <stage>` Log line the board's Flow charts read, under the tracker lock."
prompt: impl-uploads opened the pull request for Upload path check: https://github.com/o/app/pull/14, head 3f9c2a1.

the stage cell is the last structured move
